summary.text: Jane Weber is a Democratic state representative from Montana who has represented House District 19 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A forester who also served as a Cascade County commissioner, she sits on the House Taxation and Human Services committees.

paragraphs.text: Jane Weber was born in Allentown, Pennsylvania.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Kutztown State College in 1975 and another from the University of Montana in 1982, and her career experience includes working as a forester.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked for the USDA Forest Service and served as a Cascade County Commissioner for a decade.

As of 2024, she was affiliated with the Great Falls Downtown Partnership, the Great Falls Chamber of Commerce Business Advocacy Committee, the Black Eagle Technical Advisory Group, and the Missouri-Madison River Fund Board of Directors.
Weber defeated Republican Hannah Trebas in the November 5, 2024 general election and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Taxation and Human Services committees.
In the 2024 survey, Weber said she had lived in her Great Falls neighborhood for more than 30 years and raised three children who attended Great Falls Public Schools.
She listed public education funding, access to health care including support for Medicaid expansion, and fair property taxes as her key campaign messages.
